::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April. 8. 1889.  
**From:** Incoporated [Society of Authors](organizations/other_44.qmd), 4, Portugal Street, Lincoln’s Inn Fields, W. C.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin.
:::

My dear Miss Yonge

Will you kindly read the enclosed and if you approve of the petition will you kindly sign it and send it back to me here?

very truly yours
[Walter Besant](people/person_1652.qmd)
